title: Residue-field equivalence for a birational line pushforward
statement: Let $i:W\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $W$ integral [def-pc-integral-scheme]. Let $\pi:Y\to W$ be a morphism, $U\subset W$ a dense open with $\pi^{-1}(U)\to U$ an isomorphism, and $L$ an invertible module on $Y$ [def-sc-invertible-module]. Set $\eta=\operatorname{genericPoint}W$ [def-sc-generic-point], $\xi=i(\eta)$ and $G=i_*\pi_*L$. There exists an additive equivalence $e:G_\xi\simeq\kappa(\xi)$ between its module stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and the residue field [def-weil-residue-field], such that for all $a\in\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$ and $v\in G_\xi$, $e(a v)=\operatorname{residue}(a)e(v)$. No Noetherian, projective, properness, or cohomology hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: The generic point belongs to U. Restriction of pi_* L to U is pushforward along the isomorphism pi restricted to U, hence is an invertible module. A local trivialization identifies its generic stalk linearly with O_{W,eta}.

The generic local ring of integral W is a field, so its residue quotient is an isomorphism. The closed pushforward stalk equivalence identifies the stalk of G at xi with that of pi_* L at eta, with scalars induced by i.stalkMap eta.

The surjective local stalk map of a closed immersion identifies the residue fields at eta and xi. Compose the preceding additive equivalences with the inverse residue-field map. Naturality of residue maps identifies the original scalar action with multiplication by residue(a).

theorem birational_line_pushforward_generic_stalk {X W Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : W ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral W]
    (π : Y ⟶ W) (U : W.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set W))
    [IsIso (π ∣_ U)] (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] :
    ∃ e : ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
        (i.base (genericPoint W))).obj ((pushforward i).obj ((pushforward π).obj L))) ≃+
        X.residueField (i.base (genericPoint W)),
      ∀ (a : X.presheaf.stalk (i.base (genericPoint W)))
        (v : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
          (i.base (genericPoint W))).obj ((pushforward i).obj ((pushforward π).obj L))),
        e (a • v) = (X.residue (i.base (genericPoint W))) a * e v
